role: Settings sub-screens: DebugLogView (in-memory debug log list, clear, export), CrashLogView (previous crash report show/share/delete), ErrorCatalogView (warning/error catalogue with clear and text export), AddTagSheet (new custom tag name+colour form) and MetricExplanationsView/MetricExplanationRow (age-personalised HRV metric glossary).
types: DebugLogView: struct (View) — lists DebugLogger.entries newest first; Clear + Export Diagnostic Log toolbar
CrashLogView: struct (View) — shows CrashLogManager.previousCrashLog, ShareLink share, delete
ErrorCatalogView: struct (View, @MainActor) — DebugLogger.errorCatalog list, clear, ShareLink export
AddTagSheet: struct (View) — name field, 12-colour picker, preview, Save/Cancel; Save refused for blank or existing names
MetricExplanationsView: struct (View) — metric glossary with age-band RMSSD copy
MetricExplanationRow: private struct (View) — expandable metric row
CrashReportExport: struct (Transferable) — crash report written on demand for ShareLink
ErrorCatalogExport: struct (Transferable) — error catalog written on demand for ShareLink
toplevel: AddTagSheet.presetColors is a stored let of 12 SwiftUI colours (red..brown) parallel to presetColorNames. MetricExplanationRow.action defaults to nil. Comment at line 88 points to ShareSheet in Views/Utilities/ShareSheet.swift.
